title: Croydon Fog
description: A slow-burn dub workout that opens beatless and cavernous — felt-piano pads and reverberant off-beat chord stabs drifting in fog — before a sparse half-time CasioRZ1 kit and a wobbling sub bass drop in. Chopped soulful vocal phrases drift over a moody dorian progression, garage swing carrying dubstep weight through to a stripped, echoing outro.
code:
setcpm(138/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("triangle").lpf(420).room(0.7).gain(0.7),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("swpad").lpf(900).room(0.8).delay(".4:.166:.5").gain(0.55)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(380, 760)).room(0.6).gain(0.7),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("swpad").lpf(950).room(0.7).delay(".4:.166:.5").gain(0.55),
    note("<c1 ~ ~ c1 ~ ~ c1 ~>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(180, 620)).gain(0.85).shape(0.25),
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 2 ~ 4 ~ 6 ~").speed("<1 1.5>").vowel("<a o>").room(0.6).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("CasioRZ1").shape(0.3).gain(0.95),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.16, 8).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)),
    note("<c1 ~ eb1 c1 ~ ~ g0 ~>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(2).range(160, 720)).gain(0.9).shape(0.3),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("swpad").lpf(1100).room(0.5).gain(0.5).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3, 0.6)),
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 2 4 ~ 6 ~ 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5>").vowel("<a e o>").room(0.5).gain(0.6).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>/2").s("triangle").lpf(520).room(0.8).gain(0.7),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[f2,ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("swpad").lpf(1000).room(0.85).delay(".5:.25:.6").gain(0.55),
    s("rim").bank("CasioRZ1").struct("~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ x").room(0.5).gain(0.4).crush(7)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ sd ~ ~").bank("CasioRZ1").shape(0.35).gain(0.95),
    s("hh(7,8,1)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.18, 8).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("cp").bank("CasioRZ1").struct("~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~").room(0.4).gain(0.6),
    note("<c1 eb1 c1 g0 ab0 c1 eb1 g0>").s("triangle").lpf(sine.slow(3).range(150, 820)).gain(0.95).shape(0.35),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("swpad").lpf(1300).room(0.45).gain(0.5).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3, 0.65)),
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 ~ 4 6 ~ 7 ~").speed("<1 1.5 0.5 2>").vowel("<a e o>").room(0.5).gain(0.6).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("triangle").lpf(440).room(0.85).delay(".5:.33:.6").gain(0.7),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("swpad").lpf(820).room(0.9).delay(".5:.33:.6").gain(0.5),
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ ~ 4 ~ ~ ~ ~").speed(0.5).vowel("o").room(0.7).delay(".5:.25:.5").gain(0.5)
  )]
)
